title: Higher or Lower?

sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "higher" on one switch "lower" on the other

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Hold up a card.
2. Ask the switch user "Do you think the next card will be higher or lower?"
3. The switch user makes their guess "higher" or "lower" using their switches.

tooltipText: Use 2 switches for HIGHER OR LOWER?
